trigger_condition: a list prompt (e.g. 'model' after collectModelOptions filters out every custom-model entry) arrives with an empty options array
guard_snippet: if (!cards.length) return submit(0, ''); // or render an empty-state message instead of a card group
potential_consequence: Continue's handler reads cards[index].title on an undefined card and throws, hanging the run

trigger_condition: 'storage' prompt reaches onPrompt (the AUTO_LIST fixed-policy id the driver normally answers itself, per setup-driver.js:73-74)
potential_consequence: a second, live 'storage-1' row renders and duplicates the pre-inserted collapsed storage row, contradicting its own comment describing storage's mirrored answer

trigger_condition: findControlHost/row lookup returns null for the row a prompt needs (e.g. reopen path finds no row, or a row is removed unexpectedly)
potential_consequence: submit is never wired up, the onPrompt promise never resolves, and the whole setup run hangs silently with no error

trigger_condition: start() is invoked again while a previous call on the same view instance has not yet settled
guard_snippet: if (running) throw new Error('start already in progress'); running = true; try { ... } finally { running = false; }
potential_consequence: occurrenceCounts/baseMessageByPromptId/activeRowId/container are shared and clobbered between the two overlapping runs, corrupting both

trigger_condition: a prompt message's default hint itself contains parentheses (nested parens), e.g. 'URL: (default (fallback))'
guard_snippet: match balanced parens (e.g. a small paren-depth scanner) instead of /\s*\([^()]*\)\s*$/
potential_consequence: hint is left un-stripped in the visible row title and defaultValue is empty, so the input is not pre-filled and the title shows raw hint text
